import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
    static int global_n;
    
    static class Matrix {
        long[][] entry;
        
        Matrix() {
            entry = new long[33][33];
        }
        
        void setUnit() {
            for (int i = 0; i < 33; i++) {
                Arrays.fill(entry[i], 0);
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < global_n; i++) {
                entry[i][i] = 1;
            }
        }
        
        Matrix multiply(Matrix other) {
            Matrix res = new Matrix();
            for (int i = 0; i < global_n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < global_n; j++) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < global_n; k++) {
                        res.entry[i][j] = (res.entry[i][j] + entry[i][k] * other.entry[k][j]) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
            return res;
        }
    }
    
    static long input_n, input_k;
    static Matrix[] unary_base = new Matrix[70];
    static Matrix[] binary_combined = new Matrix[70];
    static Matrix[] row_movements = new Matrix[70];
    static Matrix[] col_movements = new Matrix[70];
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        input_n = scanner.nextLong();
        input_k = scanner.nextLong();
        scanner.close();
        
        global_n = (int)input_k + 1;
        
        // Initialize arrays
        for (int i = 0; i < 70; i++) {
            unary_base[i] = new Matrix();
            binary_combined[i] = new Matrix();
            row_movements[i] = new Matrix();
            col_movements[i] = new Matrix();
        }
        
        // Initialize unary operation matrices
        for (int i = 0; i <= input_k; ++i) {
            unary_base[i].setUnit();
            if (i > 0) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= input_k; ++j) {
                    unary_base[i].entry[i][j] = 1;
                }
            }
        }
        
        // Row movement matrices
        for (int i = 0; i <= input_k; ++i) {
            row_movements[i].setUnit();
            if (i == 1) {
                for (int j = 0; j < 33; j++) {
                    Arrays.fill(row_movements[i].entry[j], 0);
                }
                row_movements[i].entry[0][0] = 1;
                row_movements[i].entry[1][(int)input_k] = 1;
                for (int j = 2; j <= input_k; ++j) {
                    row_movements[i].entry[j][j-1] = 1;
                }
            } else if (i > 1) {
                row_movements[i] = row_movements[1].multiply(row_movements[i-1]);
            }
        }
        
        // Column movement matrices
        for (int i = 0; i <= input_k; ++i) {
            col_movements[i].setUnit();
            if (i == 1) {
                for (int j = 0; j < 33; j++) {
                    Arrays.fill(col_movements[i].entry[j], 0);
                }
                col_movements[i].entry[0][0] = 1;
                col_movements[i].entry[(int)input_k][1] = 1;
                for (int j = 2; j <= input_k; ++j) {
                    col_movements[i].entry[j-1][j] = 1;
                }
            } else if (i > 1) {
                col_movements[i] = col_movements[i-1].multiply(col_movements[1]);
            }
        }
        
        // Base binary combined matrix
        binary_combined[1].setUnit();
        for (int i = 1; i <= input_k; ++i) {
            binary_combined[1] = unary_base[i].multiply(binary_combined[1]);
        }
        
        // Convert n to base K representation
        List<Integer> digits = new ArrayList<>();
        long temp = input_n;
        while (temp > 0) {
            digits.add((int)(temp % input_k));
            temp /= input_k;
        }
        Collections.reverse(digits);
        
        // Build higher level combined matrices
        for (int level = 2; level <= digits.size(); ++level) {
            binary_combined[level].setUnit();
            for (int idx = 0; idx < input_k; ++idx) {
                Matrix temp1 = row_movements[idx].multiply(binary_combined[level-1]);
                Matrix temp2 = temp1.multiply(col_movements[idx]);
                Matrix temp3 = temp2.multiply(binary_combined[level]);
                binary_combined[level] = temp3;
            }
        }
        
        // Accumulate result
        Matrix result = new Matrix();
        result.setUnit();
        int current_idx = 0;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < digits.size(); ++i) {
            if (i == digits.size() - 1) {
                for (int j = 0; j < digits.get(i); ++j) {
                    result = unary_base[current_idx % (int)input_k + 1].multiply(result);
                    ++current_idx;
                }
            } else {
                for (int j = 0; j < digits.get(i); ++j) {
                    Matrix temp1 = row_movements[current_idx % (int)input_k];
                    Matrix temp2 = temp1.multiply(binary_combined[digits.size() - i - 1]);
                    Matrix temp3 = temp2.multiply(col_movements[current_idx % (int)input_k]);
                    Matrix temp4 = temp3.multiply(result);
                    result = temp4;
                    ++current_idx;
                }
            }
        }
        
        long ans = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= input_k; ++i) {
            ans = (ans + result.entry[i][0]) % MOD;
        }
        
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
